struct RunOverrides
  std::string nas_store
  std::string store
  std::string log_sink
  std::string log_service
struct Origin
  std::string rung
  std::string path
struct Origins
  Origin nas_store
  Origin store
  Origin log_sink
  Origin log_service
  Origin off
struct Snapshot
  std::string nas_store
  std::string store
  std::string log_sink
  std::string log_service
  std::map<std::string, std::string> off
  Origins origins
  std::string stamp
struct UserSettings
  std::string nas_store
  std::string store
  std::string log_sink
  std::string log_service
  std::map<std::string, std::string> off
struct UserSnapshot
  UserSettings values
  std::string revision
struct UserReplaceResult
  UserReplaceOutcome outcome
  UserSnapshot snapshot
struct ConfigObservation
  ConfigObservationOutcome outcome
  std::string cursor
  std::optional<Snapshot> snapshot

inline Snapshot decode(std::string_view data)

struct ConfigReader
  virtual Snapshot read(const RunOverrides& overrides)
template<class Transport>struct ConfigReaderClient : ConfigReader
  Transport& transport_
  Snapshot read(const RunOverrides& overrides) override
struct ConfigReaderService
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kWireName
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kCapability
struct ConfigReaderDispatcher : FrameWriter, FrameExchanger
  ConfigReader& handler
  DescribedService describe_service() const
  void write_frame(std::string_view frame) override
  std::string exchange_frame(std::string_view frame) override
struct ConfigEditor

  virtual UserReplaceResult replace_user(const std::string& expected_revision, const UserSettings& values)

  Transport& transport_
  UserSnapshot read_user() override
  UserReplaceResult replace_user(const std::string& expected_revision, const UserSettings& values) override

  std::string exchange_frame(std::string_view frame) override
